subject: Q3 investor brief: appendix handoff, legal language, and sign‑off timeline
messages:
From: Elaine Sun <elaine@capbridge.vc>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 investor brief — appendix ask & signoff timeline

Neha —

Thanks again for the initial slide set last quarter. We are starting to assemble the Q3 investor digest and need a couple of items from Redwood to close the appendix: churn / net retention cadence, unit economics slide with updated latency/cost assumptions, and the compliance/data-retention blurb that legal can sign off on.

Can you confirm whether you can deliver a draft appendix + legal-approved language by Monday 9 July? We want to circulate to the board secretariat on the 10th. If there are any blockers (procurement language, redaction needs), flag them now so we can adjust timelines.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Sun
Investor Relations
CapBridge Capital
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Sun <elaine@capbridge.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 investor brief — appendix ask & signoff timeline

Hi Elaine —

We can hit the 9 July signoff for the appendix. Attaching an outline that maps the appendix sections to owners and data sources (attached: Q3-investor-outline-v1.pdf). High level plan:
- Marissa will own the narrative and slide assembly
- Karthik will produce the unit economics + latency/cost chart
- Olga (legal) will review the compliance text and return redlines by EOD 6 July

If legal needs more time we can provide a redline-friendly doc and an annotated data lineage sheet.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategy & Investor Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q3-investor-outline-v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 investor brief — appendix ask & signoff timeline

Thanks — I pulled the outline into a draft slide deck and attached the first pass (Q3-slide-draft-v1.pptx). Quick notes:
- Appendix structure I used: 1) topline metrics 2) product economics 3) reliability & SLOs 4) compliance notes
- Need Karthik to confirm the cost-per-token and 95th/99th pLatency numbers for the "unit economics" slide (slide 6).
- Olga, please scan the compliance wording on slide 11 — the current phrasing is intentionally cautious about retention windows. If legal prefers a narrower statement we can swap in your redlines.
- Lauren, can you collate executive one-liners for the cover page (3–4 bullets)?

I've left comments in the deck where I pulled data from BI; don't hesitate to call out any source mismatches.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Investor Comms
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q3-slide-draft-v1.pptx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 investor brief — appendix ask & signoff timeline

Marissa / Neha —

I've added the latency/cost chart (see embedded image cost-latency-chart.png) and updated the assumptions slide. Important calls-out:
- We report p95 latency for production hosted API and dedicated workloads separately. For the investor appendix I recommend combining into a single "typical" column with a footnote describing the split (keeps the deck concise).
- Cost assumptions used: average prompt/response token split based on May/June workloads; included quantization impact where applicable.
- If legal requires removal of any customer-identifying metrics we should point them to the BI snapshot rather than the visualization.

Let me know if the single-column approach is acceptable — I can create both versions but want to avoid last-minute rework.

—Karthik
Sr. Data Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: cost-latency-chart.png
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 investor brief — appendix ask & signoff timeline

Team —

Quick redlines attached (legal_redlines_q3.docx). Main requests:
1) Replace "data retention: we store logs up to 12 months" with precise retention windows per data class (logs: 6 months; metrics-only aggregates: 24 months).
2) Add a parenthetical about access controls and that customer data is segmented per contract (one sentence is fine).
3) Avoid any named customer-specific callouts in public investor materials; if a customer is referenced use an anonymized identifier.

I can sign off on the language once you incorporate those three edits. If you want me to redline the PPT directly I can do that — tell me which filename/version to edit and I'll push the doc back.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_redlines_q3.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Sun <elaine@capbridge.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final Q3 investor appendix — delivered and signoff

Elaine —

Attached is the finalized appendix and the full investor deck link. We incorporated legal's redlines (retention windows and access control sentence) and consolidated the unit economics into a single column with a footnote on split workloads. Lauren provided executive one-liners for the cover.

Final deliverables:
- Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqQ3-internal/Q3-investor-pack
- Attached: Q3-investor-appendix-final.pdf (also uploaded to the Drive folder)

Please confirm you have everything you need for the board circulation tomorrow morning. If the secretariat wants a version with fewer data visuals (PDF handout) we can produce that by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — team did a great job.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategy & Investor Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q3-investor-appendix-final.pdf
